desc:
🌲 The remake of a Tower Defense based on the game Terraria

🔨Obtain unique units and forge them to gain power
🏹 New accessory, armor, and weapon system
💪 Battle against tough foes to unlock legendary treasure
🧠 Develop strategies with others against difficult bosses
👑 Climb to the top of leaderboards to earn cool titles and rewards

📢 Join the community to view new updates!
⚠️ This game is in its alpha stage
